caption.body:
Japan was the country I was most nervous about eating in as a celiac — soy sauce contains wheat, and it's in nearly everything.

Tokyo had more GF-safe options than I expected: 20 restaurants tested, nine fully dedicated gluten-free, and a 7/10 on my GF safety score. Highlights were a 100% GF kushiage counter, a celiac-aware omakase, and GF sweets in Asakusa.

Full guide with all restaurants, GF scores, and maps on the site (link in bio).
